reuse.why: Follows the existing assertBankAccountIsNotLinked style with one new assertion helper and lets Fintegra inherit it through linkSimpleFinAccount.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is defined once; only the one-line call is repeated in the five provider link functions.

placement.why: The tree already applies link preconditions in the app.method wrappers (assert...IsNotLinked before calling the link function), but the new precondition is placed inside each link implementation instead, splitting the guards across two layers.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and tests.

maintainability.why: A single named assertion with a clear error is easy to own; a new provider must remember to call it inside its link function, separately from the wrapper-level guard.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction is bypassed; the new guard is a sibling of the existing assertion.

one_place.where: The rule is defined once in assertAccountIsOpenForBankLinking in server/accounts/app.ts and every link path calls it (GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy, Akahu, Enable Banking, and Fintegra via linkSimpleFinAccount).
